question: Does a corpus filing state the reasons for the change (same metric, same pair of years)?
method: Automated search of every corpus filing for the company (prose only: the metric as the subject of a change, a causal phrase, and the compared years, in the same or the following sentence), then every positive read by hand; negatives were read by hand for the 10 driver controls, and for the 45 false-premise items only where the search returned a near miss. The false-premise count is therefore a lower bound.

true_premise_driver.where: Only gross margin % is explained (FY2026 10-K, MD&A @192490: 'Gross margin decreased... as our business model transitioned...'); the gross profit increase itself is not.
FY2025 10-K, Item 7 @263515: 'The increases in operating income and operating margin were primarily driven by lower other operating charges...'
No passage explains the change in net earnings.
FY2025 10-K discusses only '2025 Cash Flows Compared to 2024 Cash Flows' (@~160900); no older UNH filing in the corpus.
Only a note table row ($427 / $353 / $320, @417974); no discussion.
FY2025 10-K, Item 7 @105011: 'Revenues decreased by $11,277 million in 2024 compared with 2023 driven by lower revenues at BCA and BDS...'
FY2025 10-K, Item 7 @159429: '...net income attributable to Disney increased $7.4 billion... The net income and EPS increases were due to a lower effective tax rate...'

true_premise_driver.metric: net income attributable to common stockholders
true_premise_driver.where: The decrease is stated (@150676) but not explained.
FY2025 10-K compares 2025 with 2024; no 2024 vs 2023 discussion found; no older JPM filing in the corpus.
FY2025 10-K, Item 7 @348905: '2024 versus 2023. Net revenues... were $53.51 billion for 2024, 16% higher than 2023, primarily reflecting...'

search_positives_rejected_on_reading.FG-0218: segment (Google Services) operating income, not total
search_positives_rejected_on_reading.FG-0227: describes sources of operating cash, not reasons for the change
